package.name: pinkrab_bridge
package.description:
The relay between the Pinkrab studio and ROS. Publishes where the robot is on /joint_states and turns joint commands back into studio requests, so RViz, rosbag and any other ROS tool can see and drive the same robot the page does.
The bridge holds no hardware and no simulation of its own, and it runs on the desk rather than on the rig: what it needs is a network route to the studio and a ROS graph to publish into, neither of which the arms' own machine has. Named for that one job - REP-144 keeps `ros` out of a package name, and a package called for the middleware would collect whatever else arrives next.
